notes: All scales are powers of two (scale = 2^-shift), so every rescale in the pipeline is a bit shift, never a multiply/divide. Pipeline: acc1_int32 = x_int8 @ W1_int8.T + b1_int32; hidden_int8 = saturate(ReLU(round_shift_right(acc1, rescale_shift_after_layer1))); acc2_int32 = hidden_int8 @ W2_int8.T + b2_int32; predicted class = argmax(acc2) (no rescale needed on the output, argmax is scale-invariant).
